title: VAST G1-J8 preset file
description: One SOUND for the VAST G1-J8 (websynth) synthesizer: a sparse map of synth parameter values. It carries no notes, patterns or tempo — those belong to a websynth-song file. Parameters that are omitted are filled from the synth's own defaults on import, so an authored preset is always a complete, deterministic patch. Parameter ids, ranges and defaults are generated live by the app (Song panel → "AI Prompt") and by the repo's MCP server tool `get_preset_format`; they are deliberately not duplicated here, since they grow with the synth.

name.description: Preset name — also the name it is stored under on import.

params.description: Parameter id -> value. Sparse: set only what shapes the sound. Values are clamped to each parameter's registered range; a choice parameter's value is the integer index into its value map.
